The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5e170f2c29b7026e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. statement: Suppose that k is uncountable and algebraically closed of characteristic p > 3, and that X is a projective terminal threefold with KX nef, ν(KX) = 1, and n(X, KX) = 3. There exist a smooth projective threefold V , a generically finite separable morphism ρ : V → X, a very ample divisor H on V , and a nonzero effective Cartier divisor D = ∑ α mαDα, mα ∈ Z>0, gcd α mα = 1, with the following properties. (i) The support of D is connected and has simple normal crossings. The divisor D is nef, and D|Dα is numerically trivial for every α. (ii) There is no D-trivial curve through a very general point of V . Moreover D ⋅ H2 > 0 and D2 ⋅ H = 0. (iii) The invertible sheaf OD(D) is torsion. Its order will be denoted by r. (iv) For an integer b ≥ 0, an open neighborhood U of |D|, and integers bα, there is an isomorphism ω⊗pb V |U ≃ OU (B∗), B∗ = ∑ α bαDα. (2.1) Consequently KV ⋅ D ⋅ A = 0 for every Cartier divisor A on V .
